an important solution is adding some additives as solid solution strengthening [3] and dispersion strengthening [4–5].

when the HfC content rises, the ultimate tensile strength first increases to the maximum value of 1252 MPa at 1.0 wt%, and then reduces to 965 MPa due to the dispersion distribution of second phase after rolling, and the effect of dispersion strengthening is obvious.

HfC particles are distributed at W grain boundaries, and can strongly pin grain boundaries at high temperatures based on the present results, which implies that HfC can prolong the strain behavior of W-15Mo alloys at high temperatures because of their higher recrystallization temperatures.
